scripts.lint: sh -c 'if [ -d services ] && [ -n "$(ls -A services 2>/dev/null)" ]; then npm run lint --workspaces --if-present; fi'
scripts.build: sh -c 'if [ -d services ] && [ -n "$(ls -A services 2>/dev/null)" ]; then npm run build --workspaces --if-present; fi'
scripts.test: sh -c 'if [ -d services ] && [ -n "$(ls -A services 2>/dev/null)" ]; then npm run test --workspaces --if-present; fi'
